recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source edit is needed; adding redundant CarePlan prose or reverting later Goal.source/THO-binding evolution would make the current specification less accurate.
issue_request: FHIR-5147 asked whether goals should have a priority and an indication of who has the goal, such as patient or clinician. The final Patient Care resolution accepted priority as a CodeableConcept with high/medium/low-style codes and a source indication for goals.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-5147. The March 2015 Patient Care change commit db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 added Goal.priority, a GoalPriority value set, and Goal.author wording that captured whose goal it was; later Goal refactors evolved that element through expressedBy to the current Goal.source.
additional_context: Later final Goal issues refine but do not reverse the seed: FHIR-7087 clarifies Goal.priority as mutually agreed and uses acceptance/priority for participant-specific views; FHIR-28221 renames expressedBy to Goal.source and adds CareTeam; FHIR-41409 and FHIR-48366 refine source/recorder and Group support; FHIR-53104 and FHIR-56542 move priority bindings to the THO Goal Priority value set. source/fhir.ini lists CarePlan and Goal as active Patient Care resources, so source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml is in current build scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Goal.priority is a CodeableConcept with a preferred binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/goal-priority, current Goal.source indicates whose goal it is and references Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, CareTeam, and Group, and Goal.acceptance.priority covers participant-specific priority where patient, clinician, or other stakeholder priorities differ.

related_jiras.note: Clarified Goal.priority as mutually agreed and introduced participant-specific acceptance/priority context.
Renamed Goal.expressedBy to Goal.source and added CareTeam support for the same source concept.
Retained Goal.source while adding recorder semantics and refining source/recorder wording.
Moved Goal.priority binding to the THO Goal Priority value set.
Aligned Goal.acceptance.priority with the same THO Goal Priority value set.
